memory_update.text: For AI data-center power/cooling balance-of-plant, keep VRT and ETN as reference anchors, but do not let them crowd out direct second-order suppliers like POWL and MOD.
POWL maps to medium-voltage switchgear and packaged electrical systems; MOD maps to data-center cooling, hybrid cooling, and liquid-cooling thermal management.
Next Layer 1B pass should search below $10B for pumps, valves, heat exchangers, transformers, busway, coolant distribution units, commissioning, electrical installation, and MEP labor bottlenecks.
Several once-underfollowed AI infrastructure beneficiaries have re-rated above $10B by June 2026; market-cap screen alone may miss still-obscure but no-longer-small suppliers.

node: Data-center power, cooling, and electrical balance-of-plant
summary: Layer 1B expansion for the AI data-center power/cooling balance-of-plant node. The obvious reference lane remains Vertiv and Eaton: both have direct portfolios in data-center power, cooling, electrical distribution, or thermal systems and are already widely recognized. The underfollowed lane should not be forced into tiny caps because several formerly obscure suppliers have already re-rated above $10B; Powell and Modine still qualify as direct second-order chokepoint candidates because their disclosures tie growth to switchgear/power demand and data-center cooling. Main coverage gap for a later pass: smaller pump, valve, heat-exchanger, transformer, commissioning, and specialty-installation names below $10B.
